atoms.text: Regular triangles are called equilateral triangles. Equilateral triangles have 3 sides of equal length and 3 angles of equal size. This means they always look the same.
atoms.sound: Regular triangles are called eequilateral triangles. Eequilateral triangles have 3 sides of equal length and 3 angles of equal size. This means they always look the same.

atoms.text: This is called a scalene triangle. Scalene triangles have no sides of equal length and no angles of equal size. This means they can come in many different shapes and sizes.

instruction.text: Choose the correct numbers to fill in the gaps.

atoms.b: Equilateral triangles have ((0 1 2 ++3)) sides of equal length and ((0 1 2 ++3)) angles of equal size.
atoms.sound: Eequilateral triangles have 3 sides of equal length and 3 angles of equal size.

atoms.b: Scalene triangles have ((++0 1 2 3)) sides of equal length and ((++0 1 2 3)) angles of equal size.

instruction.text: Is this statement true or false?

atoms.a: Scalene triangles are always identical to one another.
